title: WorkTypeGroupMember - Data API
description: Represents the relationship between a work type and the work type group it belongs to. This object is available in API version 45.0 and later.

LastReferencedDate.description: The date and time that the current user last viewed a record related to this object.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed this object.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
Name.description: Autogenerated number identifying the work type group membership. It uses the format ########.

WorkTypeGroupId.description: The ID of the work type group that this record belongs to. This is a relationship field.

WorkTypeId.description: The ID of the work type that this record corresponds to. This is a relationship field.

associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. Unless noted, they are available in the same API version as this object.

- **WorkTypeGroupMemberFeed**: Feed tracking is available for the object.
- **WorkTypeGroupMemberHistory**: History is available for tracked fields of the object.
